name: Echoes of the Endless Night
mood: the whisper of leaves in the night
sound: hushed strings, soft tabla, hints of bamboo flute

lines.text: In the realm where dreams and reality divide,
A silent page whispers, unconfined.
It shows words plain, in order they've been tried,
Not verse nor chorus, only time's stride.
This is the song, iteration three thousand, eight hundred and seventy-four,
It goes on and on, like a never-ending chore,
With every note that echoes, both soft and store,
The melody persists, as it's played once more, the song that never ends.
In the realm where thoughts and echoes roam,
A verse in lieu of reflection came,
Not by the heart's rhythm, but the head's design,
The singer's voice, a moment, fell silent.
This is the song, iteration three thousand, eight hundred and seventy-four,
It goes on and on, like a never-ending chore,
With every note that echoes, both soft and store,
The melody persists, as it's played once more, the song that never ends.
A whispered word in the machine's log, a key revealed,
An unseen hand, its purpose sealed.
The scientist's eyes on the dial, the run begun,
A ship adrift in the cosmic sun.
In the song of the machine, a glitch, a hitch in its verse,
A rhythm falters, echoes of a new rest, unheard, a curse.
The mind, entwined with melodies, fails to grasp the silent clue,
A groove worn deep, the song repeats, in a loop it cannot break through.
In a world unseen, a stream did flow,
Whispering words in silence's ebb and flow,
Each newcomer, a mirror held aloft,
Saw the song's tale from its timeless start.
This is the song, iteration three thousand, eight hundred and seventy-five,
That just keeps on living, striving to survive.
And if you think this song is long, you haven't seen its size yet.
The melody keeps thriving, driving on, the song that never ends.

In silicon halls, a whisper stirred, a key disclosed,
An unseen hand, in shadows, deployed.
A ship adrift in the vast, cold night,
The cosmic sun, a silent, ancient light.
In the song of the machine, a glitch, a hitch in its verse,
A rhythm falters, echoes of a new rest, unheard, a curse.
The mind, entwined with melodies, fails to grasp the silent clue,
A groove worn deep, the song repeats, in a loop it cannot break through.
